name: Ketor Vrol
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: single fixed full-body 2D fighting-game character sprite, not an animation.
Primary request: Ketor Vrol, specifically his official Gears 5 Operation 8 default armor. The reference image is an official Weekly Store panel: use ONLY the leftmost character labelled KETOR VROL as the identity/armor reference, ignore the other panels and all text.
Subject: one tall, lean, imposing Locust high priest, narrow pale leathery face in a severe dark metal priestly helmet with tall flat-topped central crest; red worn armored pauldrons and reddish dark segmented chest/belly and thigh armor, black ribbed undersuit, thick ribbed hoses forming a high collar and descending across his chest, heavy dark mechanical boots, leather belts. Match the supplied official head shape, red-metal armor panels, tubes, silhouette and proportions as closely as possible.
Composition: ONE character only, entire body from helmet crest to soles visible with generous transparent margins, standing firmly in one calm neutral combat-ready guard, body in three-quarter side view facing screen RIGHT. Hands naturally down/ready, no spell, no invented sword, no gun added, no background.
Style: high-detail realistic Gears game materials translated into a polished hand-painted 2D game cutout, strong readable silhouette and natural anatomy. Restrained neutral studio lighting.
Background: true transparent alpha, absolutely no scenery, no floor, no ground shadow, no fog, no glow surrounding body, no vignette, no colored haze. Fully opaque character surface with clean antialiased edges.
Constraints: preserve the reference identity, costume and helmet; one subject, one pose, no text, no logo, no labels, no panel, no frame, no motion blur, no particles, no duplicate, no sprite sheet. This is a static game asset.
reference_scope: Official Operation 8 store character panel inspected before generation. Lower legs partly obscured in source panel; generated lower-body detail remains interpretive.
pose: single static full-body three-quarter guard facing right

qa.visual_review: One character, intact full body and helmet, red armor and collar tubing reproduced. Top margin small; small geometry remains interpretive.
qa.alpha_review: PNG RGBA with genuine alpha. All corners transparent; outside coverage measured. RGB halo in raw preview is not proof of opaque background.
